experiments.title: GPU flow field
experiments.summary: The hero's flow field runs on the GPU (WebGPU compute shader) instead of WebAssembly, so it can draw fifty to a hundred times as many particles.
experiments.measure: Holds 60 fps from 3,000 to 1,000,000 particles on an Apple GPU (Metal); the WebAssembly field reaches its limit near 150,000. At the site's own density there is no gain, which is why it is off by default.

experiments.title: Hero of the day
experiments.summary: The hero's flow field is a different picture each UTC day: the noise field moves to a new place and the particles start somewhere new. The same seed draws the same field on the WebAssembly and GPU paths.
experiments.measure: Not yet judged. A seed of 0 is the field the site has always drawn, so with the switch off nothing changes. Add ?seed=anything to any visit to pin one picture, for example /?seed=flow.
